jobs.description:
Unique Selling Proposition

Do you want to shape the applications that Life actuaries across Zurich rely on every quarter for reporting and analysis purpose? Do you enjoy turning local business needs into global solutions? Join our Group Actuarial Systems team and take ownership of our Life actuarial reporting and analytics application landscape supporting IFRS and local GAAP reporting, regulatory (e.g. SST) and management reporting, forecasting, planning and scenario analysis.

In this role, you will be the link between Life actuaries in our business units, Group and the teams who build and support the solutions. You will shape the roadmap, deliver through our actuarial support team in Bratislava and our IT delivery team in Barcelona, and look beyond what users ask for — spotting opportunities in AI, automation and agentic workflows, working closely with our Data Scientist. Guided by our values of forward-thinking, togetherness and results orientation, you will help make actuarial reporting simpler and smarter across the Group.

What you will do

• Own the Life actuarial reporting and analytics application landscape end-to-end, from business requirements through delivery to BAU support and enhancements.

• Partner with Life actuarial teams across business units to understand their processes, resolve business issues and support them through reporting cycles.

• Generalise local requirements into global, reusable solutions rather than bespoke builds, owning and prioritising the Life reporting applications roadmap.

• Deliver through others, steering our actuarial support team in Bratislava and IT delivery team in Barcelona.

• Identify enhancement opportunities beyond user requests, including AI-enabled features, automation and agentic workflows.

What you bring

• Qualified actuary with 10+ years' experience in Life actuarial roles, ideally in financial reporting, actuarial valuation or regulatory reporting.

• Track record of delivering through distributed, cross-functional teams and managing senior stakeholders across functions and markets.

• Ability to abstract local needs into global, scalable solutions and to challenge bespoke thinking.

• Interest in technology and a forward-thinking view on AI, automation and process improvement.

• Strong communication and influencing skills in English, with a collaborative, cross-cultural approach.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Information for recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

• Location(s): CH - Zürich

• Remote working: No

• Schedule: Full Time

• Recruiter name: Natalia Dzieglo

descriptionByLocale.it:
Proposizione unica S6

Vuoi configurare le applicazioni che Life attua in Zurigo si affidano a ogni trimestre per scopi di reporting e analisi? Ti piace trasformare le esigenze aziendali locali in soluzioni globali? Unisciti al nostro team di Gruppo Attuarial Systems e appropriati del nostro Life attuarial reporting e analytics application landscape che supporta gli IFRS e i derivati locali, la regolamentazione (ad esempio SST) e la reporting gestionale, la previsione, la pianificazione e l'analisi degli scenari.

In questo ruolo, sarete il collegamento tra gli attuari di Life nelle nostre business unit, il Gruppo e i team che costruiscono e supportano le soluzioni. Definirete la roadmap, consegnerete attraverso il nostro team di supporto attuariale a Bratislava e il nostro team di consegna IT a Barcellona, e guarderete oltre a ciò che gli utenti chiedono. Scoprire opportunità in AI, automazione e flussi di lavoro di workflows di agente agente, lavorando in stretta collaborazione con il nostro Data Scientist. Guidati dai nostri valori di lungimiranza, amicizia e orientamento ai risultati, aiuterete a rendere i report attuariali più semplici e intelligenti in tutto il Gruppo.

Cosa farai?

• Possedere l'applicazione di reporting e analisi di Life attuariale end-to-end, dai requisiti aziendali fino al supporto BAU e ai miglioramenti.

• Collaborare con i team attuariali Life attraverso le business unit per comprendere i processi, risolvere i problemi aziendali e supportarli attraverso cicli di reporting.

• Generalizzare i requisiti locali in soluzioni globali e riutilizzabili piuttosto che costruire bespoke, possedere e dare priorità alla tabella di marcia per le applicazioni di reporting Life.

• Consegna tramite altri, guidando il nostro team di supporto attuariale a Bratislava e il team di consegna IT a Barcellona.

• Identificare le opportunità di miglioramento oltre le richieste degli utenti, comprese le funzioni abilitate con AI, l'automazione e i flussi di lavoro di agentic.

Cosa porti?

• Attuario qualificato con esperienza di oltre 10 anni nei ruoli attuariali di Vita, idealmente nella segnalazione finanziaria, nella valutazione attuariale o nella segnalazione normativa.

• Tracciare i risultati della fornitura attraverso squadre distribuite e interfunzionali e la gestione di soggetti di alto livello attraverso funzioni e mercati.

• Capacità di astrarre le esigenze locali in soluzioni globali e di scalare e di sfidare il pensiero su misura.

• Interesse per la tecnologia e visione lungimirante su AI, automazione e miglioramento dei processi.

• Una forte comunicazione e competenze influenzanti in inglese, con un approccio collaborativo e interculturale.

Il tuo posto e' qui.

Imagine lavora in uno dei luoghi di lavoro più sostenibili al mondo. Al Campus Quai Zurigo, potrete godere di un ambiente progettato per aiutarvi a prosperare, con benefici che sostengono il vostro benessere e impatto, e opportunità di prestazioni al meglio, circondati da grandi talenti e colleghi di supporto.

Avrete accesso a opzioni alimentari sane, strutture per il fitness e spazi luminosi e collaborativi che stimolano la creatività. Situato nel cuore di Zurigo, sulle rive del Lago di Zurigo, il campus offre ottimi collegamenti con i mezzi pubblici, rendendo il vostro viaggio semplice.

Crescere con noi attraverso l'accesso alle risorse di apprendimento, lo sviluppo sul posto di lavoro, e la continua responsabilizzazione e il supporto. Essere parte di un team che sta creando un futuro più luminoso insieme.

Chi siamo

Zurigo è un'assicuratore leader in più di 200 paesi e territori con più di 65.000 dipendenti. Da oltre 150 anni Zurigo trasforma le assicurazioni. Offre non solo protezione, ma anche servizi di prevenzione che promuovono il benessere e la resilienza climatica. Guidati dal nostro obiettivo di creare insieme un futuro più luminoso, ci proponiamo di essere una delle aziende più responsabili e influenti al mondo.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua applicazione online oggi!

descriptionByLocale.de:
Einzigartiger Verkaufsvorschlag

Sie wollen die Anwendungen gestalten, auf die sich Life-Actuaries in Zürich für jeden Quartal verlassen, um Berichts- und Analysezwecke zu nutzen? Sie möchten gerne lokale Geschäftsbedürfnisse in globale Lösungen verwandeln? Schließen Sie sich unserem Team von Group Actuarial Systems an und übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für unsere Life-Actuarial Reporting and Analytics Application Landscape, die IFRS und lokale GAAP-Reporting, regulatorische (z.B. SST) und Management Reporting, Prognose, Planung und Szenarioanalyse unterstützt.

In dieser Funktion werden Sie die Verbindung zwischen den Lebensaktuarien in unseren Geschäftseinheiten, der Gruppe und den Teams, die die Lösungen aufbauen und unterstützen. Sie werden die Roadmap gestalten, über unser versicherungsmathematisches Support-Team in Bratislava und unser IT-Lieferteam in Barcelona liefern und über das hinaus schauen, was die Nutzer verlangen – die Möglichkeiten in den Bereichen KI, Automatisierung und agentische Workflows zu erkennen, und eng mit unserem Data Scientist zusammenarbeiten. Geleitet von unseren Werten des Forward-Thinking, der Zusammengehörigkeit und der Ergebnisorientierung helfen Sie, die versicherungsmathematische Berichterstattung im gesamten Konzern einfacher und intelligenter zu gestalten.

Was du tun wirst

• Das Life-Amatrikulations- und Analyse-Anwendungslandschaft von Ende zu Ende, von den Geschäftsanforderungen über die Lieferung bis hin zu Support und Verbesserungen in der bau.

• Partner mit Life-Aktuarienteams in allen Geschäftsbereichen, um ihre Prozesse zu verstehen, Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen und sie durch Berichtszyklen zu unterstützen.

• Verallgemeinern Sie lokale Anforderungen in globale, wiederverwendbare Lösungen anstatt maßgeschneiderte Builds, Eigentümer und Priorisierung der Life-Reporting-Anwendungen Roadmap.

• Liefern Sie durch andere, steuern Sie unser versicherungsmathematisches Support-Team in Bratislava und IT-Lieferung in Barcelona.

• Ermittlung von Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten über Benutzeranfragen hinaus, einschließlich KI-fähigen Funktionen, Automatisierung und agentischen Workflows.

Was du mitbringst

• Qualifizierte Versicherungsmathematik mit mehr als 10 Jahren Erfahrung in der Lebensmathematik, idealerweise in der Finanzberichterstattung, versicherungsmathematischen Bewertung oder in der regulatorischen Berichterstattung.

• Verfolgen Sie die Ergebnisse der Bereitstellung durch verteilte, funktionsübergreifende Teams und leiten Sie hochrangige Stakeholder über Funktionen und Märkte hinweg.

• Fähigkeit, lokale Bedürfnisse in globale, skalierbare Lösungen zu bündeln und maßgeschneidertes Denken herauszufordern.

• Interesse an Technologie und einem zukunftsweisenden Blick auf KI, Automatisierung und Prozessverbesserung.

• Starke Kommunikation und Einflussnahme auf Englisch, mit einem kollaborativen, kulturübergreifenden Ansatz.

Du gehörst hierher.

Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie arbeiten in einem der weltweit nachhaltigsten Arbeitsplätze. Am Campus Quai Zürich genießen Sie ein Umfeld, das Ihnen helfen soll, zu gedeihen, mit Vorteilen, die Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Wirkung unterstützen, und Möglichkeiten, sich in Ihrer besten Form zu entfalten, umgeben von Spitzentalenten und unterstützenden Kollegen.

Sie haben Zugang zu gesunden Speisen, Fitnesseinrichtungen und hellen, kollaborativen Räumen, die Kreativität wecken. Im Herzen von Zürich am Ufer des Zürichsees gelegen, bietet der Campus eine hervorragende Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, die Ihren Weg einfach machen.

Wachsen Sie mit uns durch den Zugang zu Lernressourcen, die Entwicklung am Arbeitsplatz und kontinuierliche Empowerment und Unterstützung. Seien Sie Teil eines Teams, das eine bessere gemeinsame Zukunft schafft.

Über uns

Zürich ist ein führender Mehrlinienversicherer und betreut über 82 Millionen Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Territorien mit mehr als 65.000 Mitarbeitern. Seit über 150 Jahren transformiert Zürich die Versicherung – nicht nur mit Schutz, sondern auch mit Präventionsdienstleistungen, die Wohlbefinden und Klimabeständigkeit fördern. Geleitet von unserem Ziel, „eine bessere Zukunft gemeinsam zu schaffen, wollen wir eines der verantwortungsvollsten und wirksamsten Unternehmen der Welt sein.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Proposition unique de vente

Voulez-vous façonner les applications que Life actuaires à Zurich comptent sur chaque trimestre pour la production de rapports et d'analyses? Vous aimez transformer les besoins des entreprises locales en solutions globales? Rejoignez notre équipe Groupe Actuarial Systems et prenez en charge notre paysage d'applications actuarielles Life supportant les IFRS et les rapports GAAP locaux, la réglementation (par exemple SST) et les rapports de gestion, la prévision, la planification et l'analyse de scénarios.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez le lien entre les Life Actuaries de nos unités professionnelles, Groupe et les équipes qui construisent et soutiennent les solutions. Vous façonnerez la feuille de route, fournirez par notre équipe de soutien actuariel à Bratislava et notre équipe de livraison informatique à Barcelone, et regarderez au-delà de ce que les utilisateurs demandent - repérer des opportunités dans l'IA, l'automatisation et les workflows agents, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec notre Data Scientist.

Ce que vous ferez

• Possèdent le paysage de l'analyse et de l'analyse actuarielle Life, des exigences opérationnelles aux améliorations et au soutien de l'UAB.

• S'associer aux équipes actuarielles Life dans les unités opérationnelles pour comprendre leurs processus, résoudre les problèmes opérationnels et les soutenir au moyen de cycles de rapports.

• Diffuser les exigences locales en solutions globales et réutilisables plutôt que de créer des solutions sur mesure, en possédant et en priorisant la feuille de route pour les applications de rapports Life.

• Diriger notre équipe de soutien actuariel à Bratislava et l'équipe de prestation informatique à Barcelone.

• Identifier les possibilités de mise en valeur au-delà des demandes des utilisateurs, y compris les fonctionnalités compatibles avec l'IA, l'automatisation et les flux de travail des agents.

Ce que vous apportez

• Actuaire qualifié avec 10 ans d'expérience dans les rôles actuariels Life, idéalement dans l'information financière, l'évaluation actuarielle ou l'information réglementaire.

• Suivre les résultats obtenus grâce à des équipes réparties et interfonctionnelles et gérer les principaux acteurs sur l'ensemble des fonctions et des marchés.

• Capacité d'abstraction des besoins locaux dans des solutions globales et évolutives et de remettre en question la pensée sur mesure.

• Intérêt pour la technologie et une vision prospective de l'IA, de l'automatisation et de l'amélioration des processus.

• Une communication forte et des compétences influentes en anglais, avec une approche collaborative et interculturelle.

Tu es ici.

Imaginez travailler dans l'un des lieux de travail les plus durables. Au campus Quai Zurich, vous apprécierez un environnement conçu pour vous aider à prospérer, avec des avantages qui soutiennent votre bien-être et votre impact, et des occasions de se produire à votre meilleur, entouré de talents et de collègues de soutien.

Vous aurez accès à des options de restauration saine, des installations de fitness et des espaces de collaboration lumineux qui éveillent la créativité. Situé au cœur de Zurich sur les rives du lac de Zurich, le campus offre d'excellentes liaisons de transport en commun, ce qui vous facilite la circulation.

Faites partie d'une équipe qui crée un avenir meilleur ensemble.

À propos de nous

Zurich est un assureur multiligne de premier plan, qui dessert plus de 82 millions de clients dans plus de 200 pays et territoires avec plus de 65 000 employés. Depuis plus de 150 ans, Zurich transforme l'assurance – en offrant non seulement une protection, mais aussi des services de prévention qui favorisent le bien-être et la résilience climatique.

Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre candidature en ligne aujourd'hui!

jobs.description:
136774 | 80 - 100% | Oerlikon, Zürich | Hybrid

Möchtest du eine zentrale Rolle in der Weiterentwicklung unserer Pricing-Modelle im Corporate Life & Pensions Geschäft übernehmen und aktiv zur nachhaltigen Profitabilität beitragen?

In dieser Rolle verstärkst du bei Zurich Schweiz den Geschäftsbereich Leben im Team Kollektivleben und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg.

Als Senior Pricing Actuary Corporate Life & Pensions bist du zuständig für die Entwicklung und Anwendung des Kollektivleben-Tarifs und stellst sicher, dass unsere Lösungen im Spannungsfeld von Kundenorientierung, Marktdynamik und Profitabilität optimal positioniert sind. Du arbeitest eng mit Underwriting, Aktuariat, Produktmanagement und Vertrieb zusammen und bringst deine Expertise strategisch wie operativ ein.

Das erwartet dich

• Du entwickelst den Kollektivleben-Tarif jährlich weiter, begleitest den internen Abnahmeprozess und koordinierst die Eingabe bei der FINMA

• Du stellst die Implementierung, die korrekte Umsetzung sowie die Anwendung der Bestandestarifierung des Kollektivleben-Tarifs im Verwaltungssystem sicher

• Du steuerst die Portfolio-Profitabilität aktiv und leitest datenbasierte Massnahmen zur nachhaltigen Ergebnisverbesserung ab

• Du entwickelst Pricing-Modelle, Tools und Prozesse in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Underwriting sowie Life Performance & Analytics CLP kontinuierlich weiter

• Du positionierst dich als kompetente Ansprechperson und Sparringspartner für Vertrieb und Management in Pricing-relevanten Fragestellungen

Das zeichnet dich aus

• Hochschul- oder Fachhochschulabschluss in einem quantitativen Bereich

• Laufende oder abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Aktuar SAV bzw. Bereitschaft, diese zu absolvieren

• Gute Programmierkenntnisse, idealerweise in R, sowie Erfahrung in der Weiterentwicklung von Modellen und Prozessen

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Pricing Kollektivleben oder hohe Motivation, sich in dieses Fachgebiet vertieft einzuarbeiten

• Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse

Gut zu wissen

Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: 80 - 100%

Arbeitsort: Oerlikon, Zürich

Stellenantritt: ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Reisetätigkeit: Keine Reisetätigkeiten

Hybrides Arbeiten : bis zu 40%

Alles rund um deine Bewerbung

Du kannst dich in einem ersten Schritt direkt online bei uns bewerben – dafür benötigst du nur deinen Lebenslauf. Weitere Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess findest du hier .

Wir legen Wert auf einen effizienten und wertschätzenden Bewerbungsprozess. Das Talent Acquisition Team prüft deine Bewerbung persönlich, ohne Einsatz künstlicher Intelligenz. Ab deinem ersten persönlichen Kennenlernen mit der zuständigen Führungskraft erhältst du von uns immer eine individuelle Rückmeldung. Denn wir sind überzeugt: Aussagekräftiges Feedback basiert auf dem persönlichen Austausch.

Für diese Position arbeiten wir nicht mit Personalvermittlungen zusammen. Unaufgefordert eingereichte Bewerbungen werden weder berücksichtigt noch vergütet.

Do you want to play a central role in the further development of our "Principal Life & Pensions" models in Corporate Life & Pensions and actively contribute to sustainable profitability?

In this role, you strengthen the Life in Team Team at Zurich Switzerland and make an important contribution to our joint success.

As a Senior Pricing Actuary Corporate Life & Pensions, you are responsible for the development and application of the collective life tariff and ensure that our solutions are optimally positioned in the field of customer orientation, market dynamics and profitability. You work closely with Under Paper, Aktuariat, Product Management and Sales and bring your expertise to your strategic and operational level.

That's what awaits you

• Du begleitest den jährlichen Planungs- und Steuerungsprozess und verfolgst die Umsetzung der vereinbarten operativen und finanziellen Massnahmen.

• Du erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings für interne Anspruchsgruppen und Group Claims, vertrittst die zugrunde liegenden Zahlen und stellst die erforderliche Governance sicher.

Nella nostra area Reclami Performance e Analytics nella gestione delle prestazioni CLAIMS, sei responsabile del controllo delle prestazioni della nostra più grande linea di reclamo. Lavorate all'interfaccia tra l'elaborazione dei reclami, la sottoscrizione, l'attualizzazione e l'analisi e quindi sostenete il continuo sviluppo del trattamento dei crediti e gli obiettivi strategici della Svizzera di Zurigo.

Avete la capacità di classificare in modo comprensibile i dati complessi e di ricavare raccomandazioni chiare e attuabili da esso? Apprezzi la collaborazione con diverse aree specializzate e vuoi danneggiare i tuoi risultati tranne che per la gestione dell'area? Questa è la tua prossima opportunità di carriera.

Scopri qui perché Zurigo Svizzera è uno dei datori di lavoro “Top 3” in Svizzera. Diventa parte di esso e applica come Reclami Performance Manager MF.

Cosa fai

• Siete responsabili del controllo delle prestazioni nel settore dei veicoli a motore: sviluppate e monitorate i KPI, analizzate le deviazioni e ricavate misure concrete per la spesa per danni, l'efficienza, la perdita e la soddisfazione del cliente.

• Analizzi in modo indipendente grandi scorte di dati – dalla preparazione ai dati all'interpretazione – con SQL così come Python o PySpark e sviluppi continuamente approcci di analisi basati sui dati.

• Accompagnate il processo di pianificazione e controllo annuale per la vostra linea e seguite l'attuazione delle misure operative e finanziarie concordate nel corso dell'anno.

• Crea report significativi per le parti interessate interne e i reclami di gruppo, rappresenta i dati sottostanti e assicura la governance necessaria.

• Lei è un partner di sparring: per i gestori di linea e lavorare a stretto contatto con l'elaborazione di reclami, la sottoscrizione, l'azionariato e l'analisi per collegare efficacemente i requisiti di reparto, dati e controllo.

Cosa porti

• Hai una laurea in economia, statistica, scienze dei dati, matematica (economia) o una zona tematica comparabile.

• Si porta diversi anni di esperienza nell'assicurazione non vita, idealmente nell'ambiente di proprietà o prestazioni, ad esempio nei settori dei veicoli a motore, proprietà o responsabilità.

• Si lavora in modo sicuro con SQL e Python, idealmente con PySpark, e hanno esperienza con grandi set di dati e strumenti di reporting come Power BI.

• È possibile classificare analisi complesse in modo comprensibile, formulare raccomandazioni chiare e attuabili e rappresentarle in modo convincente ai leader.

• Si lavora in modo indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione, attivamente guidare argomenti in avanti

• Si comunica con stile in tedesco e inglese.

Are you fascinated by how claims processes in the field of motor vehicles can be further developed with data? Do you want to derive concrete measures from analyses that measurably improve the damage effort, efficiency and customer satisfaction?

In our Claims Performance and Analytics area in performance management CLAIMS, you are responsible for the performance control of our largest claim line. You work at the interface between claims processing, underwriting, actuarial and analytics and thus support the continuous development of claims processing and the strategic goals of Zurich Switzerland.

Do you have the ability to understandably classify complex data and derive clear, actionable recommendations from it? Do you appreciate the cooperation with different specialist areas and do you want to harm your findings except for area management? This is your next career opportunity.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the “Top 3” employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as Claims Performance Manager MF.

What you do

• You are responsible for performance control in the motor vehicle sector: You develop and monitor KPIs, analyze deviations and derive concrete measures for damage expenditure, efficiency, leakage and customer satisfaction.

• You analyze large data stocks independently – from data preparation to interpretation – with SQL as well as Python or PySpark and continuously develop data-based analysis approaches.

• You accompany the annual planning and control process for your line and follow the implementation of the agreed operational and financial measures over the year.

• You create meaningful reporting for internal stakeholders and group claims, represent the underlying figures and ensure the necessary governance.

• You are a sparring partner: for the line managers and work closely with claims processing, underwriting, actuarial and analytics to effectively connect department, data and control requirements.

What you bring

• You have a university degree in economics, statistics, data science, (economics) mathematics or a comparable subject area.

• You bring several years of experience in non-life insurance, ideally in the property or performance environment, for example in the areas of motor vehicles, property or liability.

• You work safely with SQL and Python, ideally with PySpark, and have experience with large datasets as well as reporting tools such as Power BI.

• You can classify complex analyses in an understandable way, formulate clear and actionable recommendations and represent them convincingly to leaders.

• You work independently, structured and solution-oriented, actively drive forward topics

• You communicate stylishly in German and English.

Your contact

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant: Bernd Makasy (+41 44 628 42 14)

Additional information

Place of work: Zurich, Oerlikon

Hybrid work: up to 40%

jobs.description:
Zurich Insurance Group is transforming its end-to-end Financial Accounting & Reporting (FAR) landscape. Sitting within the Group Technology Organisation, Finance, Investments & Treasury department, you will own solution architecture across the full reporting chain — from Finance Hub into SAP FICO, through GRDC consolidation into SAP Group Reporting, and through to Disclosure Management. Cutting across this chain are strategic platform initiatives around BDC, Data Sphere, and Master Data. This is a hands-on role — you are expected to get into the detail, not just the slide deck.

What you will do

• Own end-to-end architecture from Finance Hub ingest through FICO, GRDC, GR, and Disclosure Management

• Lead solution design for GR/GRDC consolidation flows and upstream FICO dependencies

• Architect the Finance Hub integration layer and the Disclosure Management connection to GR

• Shape BDC / Data Sphere as the analytical and automation platform alongside the SAP core, on AWS

• Partner with central finance functions and business units to accelerate the financial close cycle

• Own architecture decisions and sign-off artefacts; lead design reviews and resolve cross-stream technical risks

• Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards, data governance, and security policies

• Govern Tooling within the System Landscape

What you bring

• 8+ years in IT solution architecture or senior SAP technical consulting

• Deep hands-on expertise in SAP FICO, Experience in SAP Group Reporting (S/4HANA), including GRDC as advantage

• Understanding of the full FAR chain — Finance Hub, FICO close, GRDC rollups, GR, Disclosure Management

• Experience with SAP BDC / Data Sphere or comparable analytical platform architecture is a strong advantage

• Experience designing and building solutions across the existing Landscape

• Comfortable at code/config level — prototyping, reviewing specs, validating implementations hands-on

• Fluent in English; German is a plus

What Makes This Role Distinct

This is not a single-product assignment. You will architect across the entire financial reporting value chain — from the first byte entering Finance Hub to the last number published in a disclosure report — while shaping the next-generation analytical platform on BDC and AWS. The expectation is simple: you lead by doing and getting things done.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.
You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.
Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Information for recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

• Location(s): CH - Zürich

• Remote working: Hybrid

• Schedule: Full Time

• Recruiter name: Grace Cunningham

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Gruppo di Assicurazione di Zurigo sta trasformando il suo paesaggio end-to-end Financial Accounting & Reporting (FAR). Seduto all'interno del dipartimento di Organizzazione Tecnologica del Gruppo, Finanza, Investimenti e Tesoro, possederai un'architettura di soluzioni in tutta la catena di reportistica completa, dal Finance Hub a SAP FICO, attraverso il consolidamento del GRDC in SAP Group Reporting, e attraverso la Gestione del Disclosure. Tagliare attraverso questa catena sono iniziative strategiche di piattaforma intorno a BDC, Data Sphere e Master Data. Questo è un ruolo pratico — si prevede di entrare nel dettaglio, non solo il ponte di scorrimento.

Cosa farai

• Proprio architettura end-to-end da Finance Hub ingest attraverso FICO, GRDC, GR e Gestione di Disclosure

• Progettazione della soluzione di piombo per flussi di consolidamento GR/GRDC e dipendenze FICO a monte

• Architetto lo strato di integrazione di Finance Hub e la connessione di Gestione del Disclosure a GR

• Forma BDC / Data Sphere come piattaforma analitica e automazione insieme al core SAP, su AWS

• Partner con funzioni di finanza centrale e business unit per accelerare il ciclo di chiusura finanziario

• Decisioni di architettura proprie e artefatti firmati; recensioni di lead design e risolvere i rischi tecnici cross-stream

• Assicurare l'allineamento con gli standard di architettura aziendale, la governance dei dati e le politiche di sicurezza

• Governare gli strumenti all'interno del sistema Paesaggio

Cosa porti

• 8+ anni in architettura delle soluzioni IT o consulenza tecnica SAP senior

• Esperienza pratica profonda in SAP FICO, Experience in SAP Group Reporting (S/4HANA), incluso GRDC come vantaggio

• Comprensione della catena FAR completa — Finance Hub, FICO close, GRDC rollups, GR, Disclosure Management

• L'esperienza con SAP BDC / Data Sphere o simili architetture analitiche della piattaforma è un vantaggio forte

• Esperienza di progettazione e costruzione soluzioni in tutto il paesaggio esistente

• Confortevole a livello di codice/config — prototipazione, revisione delle specifiche, validazione delle implementazioni hands-on

• Fluente in inglese; tedesco è un plus

Ciò che rende questo distinct del ruolo

Questo non è un incarico a un singolo prodotto. Potrai architetto attraverso l'intera catena del valore di reporting finanziario — dal primo byte entrare Finance Hub all'ultimo numero pubblicato in un rapporto di divulgazione — mentre la modellazione della piattaforma analitica di prossima generazione su BDC e AWS. L'attesa è semplice: si guida facendo e facendo le cose fatte.

Tu appartieni qui.

Immaginate di lavorare in uno dei luoghi di lavoro più sostenibili del mondo. Presso il Quai Zurich Campus, ti godrai di un ambiente progettato per aiutarti a prosperare, con benefici che supportano il tuo benessere e l'impatto, e opportunità di esibirti al meglio, circondati da grandi talenti e colleghi di supporto.
Avrete accesso a opzioni di cibo sano, strutture fitness, e spazi luminosi e collaborativi che scintillano la creatività. Situato nel cuore di Zurigo, sulle rive del Lago di Zurigo, il campus offre ottimi collegamenti con i mezzi pubblici, rendendo il vostro viaggio semplice.
Crescere con noi attraverso l'accesso alle risorse di apprendimento, lo sviluppo on-the-job, e l'empowerment continuo e il supporto. Fai parte di una squadra che sta creando un futuro più luminoso insieme.

Informazioni su di noi

Zurigo è un'azienda multi-linea leader, con oltre 82 milioni di clienti in oltre 200 paesi e territori con oltre 65.000 dipendenti.
Da oltre 150 anni, Zurigo sta trasformando l'assicurazione – offrendo non solo protezione, ma anche servizi di prevenzione che promuovono il benessere e la resilienza climatica.
Guidato dal nostro scopo di “creare un futuro più luminoso insieme”, ci proponiamo di essere una delle aziende più responsabili e d’impatto al mondo.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online oggi!

Informazioni sulle agenzie di reclutamento

Zurigo non accetta domande da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. Rifiutiamo qualsiasi responsabilità per le applicazioni non richieste, così come eventuali commissioni associate.

Perché Zurigo

A Zurigo, ci piace pensare al di fuori della scatola e sfidare lo status quo. Prendiamo un approccio ottimista concentrandoci sui positivi e chiedendo costantemente cosa può andare bene?

Siamo un datore di lavoro pari opportunità che sa che ogni dipendente è unico - questo è ciò che rende il nostro team così grande!
Unisciti a noi mentre esploriamo costantemente nuovi modi per proteggere i nostri clienti e il pianeta.

• Posizione(i): CH - Zürich

• Funzionamento remoto: ibrido

• Orari: Tempo pieno

• Nome del reclutatore: Grace Cunningham

jobs.title: Global Head of Risk Advisory
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building something new and successful – helping our customers become more resilient to risks while shaping Zurich’s global risk advisory agenda?

Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) is Zurich’s dedicated commercial risk engineering and risk advisory business, working as a trusted advisor for underwriting, insurance customers and independent risk advisory customers. We provide customers with services and solutions that help them understand, manage and reduce their risks – from Core Risk Engineering Lines: Property, Casualty, Energy, Construction & Marine, to climate and natural hazards, to cyber, supply chain and other emerging risks.

As Global Head of Risk Advisory, you will own ZRS’s global risk advisory proposition and thought leadership. Together with the vertical & country leaders, you will drive the development of risk advisory solutions and business development across markets. In this role – and working closely with colleagues across Underwriting, Risk Engineering and our local business units, you will ensure Zurich builds a leading position in Climate, Cyber, Business Continuity and Enterprise Risk Management.

What you will do

• Grow the Risk Advisory business by leading the development of ZRS’s overall advisory proposition for both new/independent customers and existing Zurich clients.

• Define the global distribution and go to market approach for new/independent customers.

• Lead a team of global vertical leaders (e.g. Cyber, Climate, Business Continuity Management (BCM) and Enterprise

• Risk Management (ERM) to shape their respective propositions and ensure cross leveraging of expertise, capabilities, insights and tools.

• Lead Zurich’s thought leadership agenda on resilience, including external publications, customer engagements, conference participation and industry partnerships.

• Oversee the customer-facing risk advisory teams that work across many of our countries and regions.

• Alongside the country leaders, drive the business development activity across markets by working with local ZRS and Commercial teams to embed risk advisory solutions into propositions, customer conversations and go to market strategies.

• Monitor market trends, regulatory developments and stakeholder expectations related to resilience, and translate insights into actionable initiatives and solution enhancements.

• Work with ZRS leaders and SMEs to develop concrete risk mitigation strategies for our customers across geographies and industries, and to develop integrated propositions that bring the best of ZRS cross-line of business capabilities to our customers.

• Collaborate closely with Group Risk, Underwriting, and other key stakeholders to integrate risk advisory solutions into Zurich’s broader strategy and commercial offering.

• Explore partnership opportunities to enhance the service offering to customers.

• Provide strategic guidance and coaching to regional and local teams on key topics to build capabilities and ensure consistent delivery of our risk advisory proposition.

What you bring

• Several years of experience in risk advisory, consulting, risk engineering or a related field, ideally with exposure to clients from many sectors.

• Proven track record in developing and/or delivering risk advisory propositions, solutions or services in a complex, international environment, showcasing tangible customer impact.

• Significant track record of commercial success in building/scaling a new business/proposition, including business development and direct customer interactions.

• Ability to translate technical risk concepts into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders and customers.

• Proven ability to build and leverage a strong network of prospective customers.

• Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with experience working across functions and geographies.

• The ability to influence and lead in a global matrix structure.

• Strategic mindset combined with hands-on execution capability – comfortable moving from concept development to practical implementation.

• Excellent communication skills in English (spoken and written); additional languages are an advantage.

• A growth-oriented, proactive and resilient mindset, with a genuine passion for sustainability and helping customers build resilience.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.
You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.
Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.

Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Information for recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about helping customers become more resilient to climate risks and shaping Zurich’s global climate resilience agenda?

Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) is Zurich’s dedicated commercial risk engineering and risk advisory business. We act as a trusted partner to underwriting teams, insurance customers and independent advisory clients. Our experts provide services and solutions that help customers understand, manage and reduce their risks – from core risk engineering lines such as Property, Casualty, Energy, Construction & Marine, through to climate and natural hazards, cyber, supply chain and other emerging risks.

As Global Head of Climate Resilience, you will own ZRS’s global climate resilience advisory proposition and thought leadership. Together with the country leaders, you will drive the development of climate-related risk solutions and business development across markets. In this role, you will ensure Zurich maintains a leading position in climate resilience, working closely with colleagues across Sustainability, Underwriting, Risk Engineering and our local business units.

What you will do

• Own ZRS’s global climate resilience advisory proposition, ensuring it is relevant, differentiated and aligned with Zurich’s sustainability ambitions and customer needs.

• Lead Zurich’s thought leadership agenda on climate resilience, including external publications, customer engagements, conference participation and industry partnerships.

• Lead a team of technical Climate Resilience professionals who drive the development and enhancement of climate-related risk solutions (e.g. analytics, advisory services, tools and methodologies) that help customers understand and manage physical and transition climate risks.

• Oversee the customer-facing advisory teams that work across many of our countries and regions.

• Alongside the country leaders, drive the business development activity across markets by working with local ZRS and

• Commercial teams to embed climate resilience solutions into propositions, customer conversations and go to market strategies.

• Monitor market trends, regulatory developments and stakeholder expectations related to climate resilience, and translate insights into actionable initiatives and solution enhancements.

• Work with ZRS leaders and SMEs to develop concrete risk mitigation strategies for our customers across geographies and industries, and to develop integrated propositions that bring the best of ZRS cross-line of business capabilities to our customers.

• Collaborate closely with Sustainability, Group Risk, Underwriting, and other key stakeholders to integrate climate resilience into Zurich’s broader sustainability strategy and commercial offering.

• Explore partnership opportunities to enhance the service offering to customers.

• Provide strategic guidance and coaching to regional and local teams on climate resilience topics to build capabilities and ensure consistent delivery of our advisory proposition.

What you bring

• Several years of experience in climate risk, sustainability, risk advisory, consulting or a related field, ideally with exposure to clients from many sectors.

• Strong expertise in climate-related risks (physical and/or transition) and their implications for businesses, infrastructure and communities.

• Expertise in risk engineering and underwriting.

• Proven track record in developing and/or delivering advisory propositions, solutions or services in a complex, international environment.

• Track record of commercial success in building/growing a business.

• Ability to translate technical climate and risk concepts into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders and customers.

• Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with experience working across functions and geographies.

• The ability to influence and lead in a global matrix structure.

• Strategic mindset combined with hands-on execution capability – comfortable moving from concept development to practical implementation.

• Excellent communication skills in English (spoken and written); additional languages are an advantage.

• A growth-oriented, proactive and resilient mindset, with a genuine passion for sustainability and helping customers build climate resilience.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.
Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Information for recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di aiutare i clienti a diventare più resilienti ai rischi climatici e a plasmare l'agenda globale di resistenza al clima di Zurigo?

Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) è un’attività di consulenza per il rischio commerciale dedicata a Zurigo, che lavora come consulente di fiducia per la sottoscrittura, i clienti assicurativi e i clienti di consulenza indipendenti. Forniamo ai clienti servizi e soluzioni che li aiutano a comprendere, gestire e ridurre i loro rischi – dai rischi climatici e naturali ai cyber, supply chain e altri rischi emergenti. La resilienza Climatica è un pilastro fondamentale della nostra strategia di sostenibilità e un differenziatore chiave nella nostra offerta clienti.

Come Global Head of Climate Resilience, possederai la proposizione consulenza di ZRS per la resilienza del clima e la leadership del pensiero. Insieme con i leader del paese, guiderà lo sviluppo di soluzioni di rischio legate al clima e lo sviluppo di business attraverso i mercati. In questo ruolo, si assicurerà che Zurigo manterrà una posizione di primo piano nella resilienza del clima, lavorando a stretto contatto con i colleghi di Sustainability, Underwriting, Risk Engineering e le nostre unità aziendali locali.

Cosa farai

- La proposta di consulenza sulla resilienza climatica globale di Own ZRS, assicurandosi che sia rilevante, differenziato e allineato alle ambizioni e alle esigenze della sostenibilità di Zurigo.

- Guidare l'agenda di leadership di pensiero di Zurigo sulla resilienza del clima, tra cui pubblicazioni esterne, impegni dei clienti, partecipazione delle conferenze e partnership del settore.

- Guidare un team di professionisti tecnici di Climate Resilience che guidano lo sviluppo e la valorizzazione delle soluzioni di rischio legate al clima (ad esempio analisi, servizi di consulenza, strumenti e metodologie) che aiutano i clienti a comprendere e gestire i rischi climatici fisici e di transizione.

- Superare i team di consulenza orientati al cliente che lavorano in molti dei nostri paesi e regioni.

- Accanto ai leader del paese, guidare l'attività di sviluppo aziendale sui mercati lavorando con ZRS locale e

- I team commerciali per incorporare soluzioni di resilienza climatica in proposizioni, conversazioni con i clienti e andare a strategie di mercato.

- Monitorare le tendenze del mercato, gli sviluppi normativi e le aspettative degli stakeholder relative alla resilienza del clima, e tradurre intuizioni in iniziative e miglioramenti delle soluzioni attuabili.

- Lavorare con i leader ZRS e le PMI per sviluppare strategie di mitigazione del rischio concreto per i nostri clienti attraverso geografie e industrie, e per sviluppare proposizioni integrate che portano il meglio di ZRS cross-line di capacità aziendali ai nostri clienti.

- Collabora a stretto contatto con Sostenibilità, Rischio di Gruppo, Sottoscrittura e altri stakeholder chiave per integrare la resilienza del clima nella più ampia strategia di sostenibilità e nell’offerta commerciale di Zurigo.

- Esplora opportunità di partnership per migliorare l'offerta di servizi ai clienti.

- Fornire indicazioni strategiche e coaching a squadre regionali e locali su temi di resilienza climatica per costruire capacità e garantire la fornitura coerente della nostra proposta di consulenza.

Cosa porti

- Diversi anni di esperienza nel campo del rischio climatico, della sostenibilità, della consulenza ai rischi, della consulenza o di un campo correlato, idealmente con l'esposizione ai clienti di molti settori.

- Forte competenza nei rischi legati al clima (fisica e/o transizione) e le loro implicazioni per le imprese, le infrastrutture e le comunità.

- Competenza in ingegneria dei rischi e sottoscrizione.

- Provato track record nello sviluppo e/o nella fornitura di proposizioni, soluzioni o servizi di consulenza in un ambiente complesso e internazionale.

- Tracciare il record di successo commerciale nella costruzione / crescita di un business.

- Capacità di tradurre il clima tecnico e i concetti di rischio in chiare e attuabili intuizioni per gli stakeholder senior e i clienti.

- Forte capacità di gestione e collaborazione degli stakeholder, con esperienza di lavoro tra funzioni e geografie.

- La capacità di influenzare e condurre in una struttura di matrice globale.

- Mindset strategico combinato con la capacità di esecuzione hands-on – comodo passare dallo sviluppo del concetto all'implementazione pratica.

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese (spoken e scritto); lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

- Una mentalità orientata alla crescita, proattiva e resiliente, con una vera passione per la sostenibilità e aiutando i clienti a costruire resilienza climatica.

Tu appartieni qui.

Immaginate di lavorare in uno dei luoghi di lavoro più sostenibili del mondo. Presso il Quai Zurich Campus, ti godrai di un ambiente progettato per aiutarti a prosperare, con benefici che supportano il tuo benessere e l'impatto, e opportunità di esibirti al meglio, circondati da grandi talenti e colleghi di supporto.

Avrete accesso a opzioni di cibo sano, strutture fitness, e spazi luminosi e collaborativi che scintillano la creatività. Situato nel cuore di Zurigo, sulle rive del Lago di Zurigo, il campus offre ottimi collegamenti con i mezzi pubblici, rendendo il vostro viaggio semplice.
Crescere con noi attraverso l'accesso alle risorse di apprendimento, lo sviluppo on-the-job, e l'empowerment continuo e il supporto. Fai parte di una squadra che sta creando un futuro più luminoso insieme.

Informazioni su di noi

Zurigo è un'azienda multi-linea leader, con oltre 82 milioni di clienti in oltre 200 paesi e territori con oltre 65.000 dipendenti.
Da oltre 150 anni, Zurigo sta trasformando l'assicurazione – offrendo non solo protezione, ma anche servizi di prevenzione che promuovono il benessere e la resilienza climatica.
Guidato dal nostro scopo di “creare un futuro più luminoso insieme”, ci proponiamo di essere una delle aziende più responsabili e d’impatto al mondo.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online oggi!

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, Kunden zu helfen, widerstandsfähiger gegenüber Klimarisiken zu werden und die globale Klimaschutz-Agenda von Zurich zu gestalten?

Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) ist das spezialisierte Business Risk Advisory von Zurich und arbeitet als Trusted Advisor für Underwriting, Versicherungskunden und unabhängige Beratungskunden. Wir bieten unseren Kunden Dienstleistungen und Lösungen, die ihnen helfen, ihre Risiken zu verstehen, zu managen und zu reduzieren – von Klima- und Naturgefahren bis hin zu Cyber-, Lieferketten- und anderen aufkommenden Risiken. Klimaresilienz ist eine Kernsäule unserer Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie und ein wesentliches Unterscheidungsmerkmal in unserem Kundenangebot.

Als Global Head of Climate Resilience werden Sie das globale Klimaresilienz-Beratungsangebot und die Vordenkerrolle von ZRS besitzen. Gemeinsam mit den Staats- und Regierungschefs werden Sie die Entwicklung klimabezogener Risikolösungen und die Geschäftsentwicklung in allen Märkten vorantreiben. In dieser Funktion stellen Sie sicher, dass Zurich eine führende Position im Bereich der Klimaresistenz einnimmt, indem Sie eng mit Kollegen aus den Bereichen Nachhaltigkeit, Underwriting, Risk Engineering und unseren lokalen Geschäftseinheiten zusammenarbeiten.

Was du tun wirst

- Eigenes globales Klimaresilienz-Beratungsangebot von ZRS, um sicherzustellen, dass es relevant, differenziert und auf die Nachhaltigkeitsambitionen und Kundenbedürfnisse von Zurich abgestimmt ist.

- Führen Sie die Vordenkeragenda von Zurich zu Klimaresilienz, einschließlich externer Publikationen, Kundenbindungen, Konferenzteilnahme und Branchenpartnerschaften.

- Führen Sie ein Team von Experten für Klimaresilienz, die die Entwicklung und Verbesserung klimabezogener Risikolösungen vorantreiben (z. B. Analysen, Beratungsdienste, Tools und Methoden), die Kunden dabei helfen, physische und Übergangs-Klimarisiken zu verstehen und zu managen.

- Beaufsichtigen Sie die kundenorientierten Beratungsteams, die in vielen unserer Länder und Regionen arbeiten.

- Führen Sie neben den Landesführern die Geschäftsentwicklung über Märkte hinweg durch die Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen ZRS und

- Kommerzielle Teams, um Lösungen zur Klimaresistenz in Vorschläge, Kundengespräche und Marktstrategien einzubetten.

- Überwachung von Markttrends, regulatorischen Entwicklungen und Erwartungen der Stakeholder in Bezug auf die Klimaresistenz und Umsetzung von Erkenntnissen in umsetzbare Initiativen und Lösungsverbesserungen.

- Arbeiten Sie mit ZRS-Führungskräften und KMU zusammen, um konkrete Risikominderungsstrategien für unsere Kunden in allen Regionen und Branchen zu entwickeln und integrierte Vorschläge zu entwickeln, die unseren Kunden das Beste aus den Geschäftsmöglichkeiten von ZRS bringen.

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Nachhaltigkeit, Group Risk, Underwriting und anderen wichtigen Stakeholdern, um die Klimaresilienz in die breitere Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie und das kommerzielle Angebot von Zurich zu integrieren.

- Entdecken Sie Partnerschaftsmöglichkeiten, um das Serviceangebot für Kunden zu verbessern.

- Strategische Beratung und Coaching für regionale und lokale Teams zu Themen der Klimaresilienz, um Fähigkeiten aufzubauen und eine konsistente Umsetzung unseres Beratungsangebots sicherzustellen.

Was du mitbringst

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in den Bereichen Klimarisiko, Nachhaltigkeit, Risikoberatung, Beratung oder einem verwandten Bereich, idealerweise mit Kunden aus vielen Branchen.

- Starke Expertise in klimabezogenen Risiken (physische und / oder Übergang) und deren Auswirkungen auf Unternehmen, Infrastruktur und Gemeinden.

- Expertise in Risk Engineering und Underwriting.

- Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung und / oder Bereitstellung von Beratungsangeboten, Lösungen oder Dienstleistungen in einem komplexen, internationalen Umfeld.

- Track Record des kommerziellen Erfolgs beim Aufbau / Wachstum eines Unternehmens.

- Fähigkeit, technische Klima- und Risikokonzepte in klare, umsetzbare Erkenntnisse für Senior Stakeholder und Kunden zu übersetzen.

- Starke Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management und in der Zusammenarbeit mit Erfahrung in allen Funktionen und Regionen.

- Die Fähigkeit, eine globale Matrixstruktur zu beeinflussen und zu führen.

- Strategisches Mindset kombiniert mit praktischer Ausführungsfähigkeit – bequemer Wechsel von der Konzeptentwicklung zur praktischen Umsetzung.

- Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch (gesprochen und geschrieben); zusätzliche Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

- Eine wachstumsorientierte, proaktive und widerstandsfähige Denkweise mit einer echten Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit und der Unterstützung der Kunden beim Aufbau einer Klimaresistenz.

Du gehörst hierher.

Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie arbeiten an einem der nachhaltigsten Arbeitsplätze der Welt. Auf dem Quai Zürich Campus genießen Sie eine Umgebung, die Ihnen helfen soll, zu gedeihen, mit Vorteilen, die Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Wirkung unterstützen, und Möglichkeiten, Ihre besten Leistungen zu erbringen, umgeben von Top-Talenten und unterstützenden Kollegen.

Sie haben Zugang zu gesunden Nahrungsmitteln, Fitnesseinrichtungen und hellen, kollaborativen Räumen, die Kreativität auslösen. Im Herzen von Zürich am Ufer des Zürichsees gelegen, bietet der Campus eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel, die Ihren Weg zur Arbeit vereinfachen.
Wachsen Sie mit uns durch den Zugang zu Lernressourcen, On-the-Job-Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Ermächtigung und Unterstützung. Seien Sie Teil eines Teams, das gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schafft.

Über uns

Zurich ist ein führender Multiline-Versicherer, der über 82 Millionen Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen mit mehr als 65.000 Mitarbeitern betreut.
Seit über 150 Jahren verändert Zürich die Versicherung – und bietet nicht nur Schutz, sondern auch Präventionsleistungen, die Wohlbefinden und Klimaresistenz fördern.
Geleitet von unserem Ziel, gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft zu schaffen, wollen wir eines der verantwortungsvollsten und wirkungsvollsten Unternehmen der Welt sein.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung noch heute!

Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) est l'entreprise dédiée de conseil en risques commerciaux de Zurich, travaillant comme un conseiller de confiance pour la souscription, les clients d'assurance et les clients de conseil indépendants. Nous fournissons aux clients des services et des solutions qui les aident à comprendre, gérer et réduire leurs risques – des risques climatiques et naturels aux risques cybernétiques, à la chaîne d'approvisionnement et à d'autres risques émergents. La résilience climatique est un pilier essentiel de notre stratégie de durabilité et un différenciateur clé de notre offre client.

En tant que Responsable Mondial de la Résilience Climatique, vous posséderez la proposition consultative de résilience climatique globale ZRS. En collaboration avec les chefs de pays, vous dirigerez le développement de solutions de risque liées au climat et le développement des affaires à travers les marchés. Dans ce rôle, vous veillerez à ce que Zurich conserve une position de leader en matière de résilience climatique, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des collègues dans les domaines de la durabilité, de la souscription, de l'ingénierie des risques et de nos unités commerciales locales.

Ce que vous ferez

- Sa propre proposition de conseil sur la résilience climatique mondiale ZRS, en s'assurant qu'elle est pertinente, différenciée et alignée sur les ambitions de développement durable de Zurich et les besoins des clients.

- Leader Zurich a pensé programme de leadership sur la résilience climatique, y compris des publications externes, des engagements des clients, la participation à des conférences et des partenariats industriels.

- Diriger une équipe de professionnels de la résilience au climat qui orientent le développement et l'amélioration de solutions de risque liées au climat (p. ex., analyses, services consultatifs, outils et méthodologies) qui aident les clients à comprendre et à gérer les risques climatiques physiques et de transition.

- Surveillez les équipes de conseil orientées vers les clients qui travaillent dans de nombreux pays et régions.

- Aux côtés des leaders du pays, pilotez l'activité de développement des entreprises sur les marchés en travaillant avec ZRS local et

- Des équipes commerciales pour intégrer des solutions de résilience climatique dans des propositions, des conversations avec les clients et des stratégies de marché.

- Un état d'esprit stratégique combiné avec une capacité d'exécution pratique – un passage confortable de l'élaboration du concept à la mise en œuvre pratique.

Are you fascinated by the connection between self-employed sales, well-founded clarifications and contact with different people? Would you like to use your experience in property and liability insurance to find fair and sustainable solutions for our customers even in demanding situations?

In this role, you will deal with complex claims cases in general liability – such as company and private liability – as well as in various types of non-life insurance. You accompany the cases from the first investigation to the conclusion, assess cover and liability and conduct negotiations with all parties involved.

You are regularly travelling in the Zurich region, visiting damage locations and clarifying matters directly on site. With your confident appearance, your negotiating skills and your understanding of the situation of those affected, you create trust – even if interests are different. At the same time, you take decisions on your own responsibility and ensure careful and efficient damage processing.

If you are looking for a versatile task with creative scope and would like to competently support customers in the event of damage, we look forward to your application.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as a damage inspector.

What you do

- You handle complex claims in property and general liability insurance independently – from claim notification to conclusion.

- You clarify matters with insurance companies, injured parties, experts, lawyers and insurance companies and visit damage locations in the Zurich region.

- You assess insurance coverage, liability and scope of damage, document your clarifications and make decisions within your competences.

- You negotiate with all parties involved, coordinate the necessary measures and initiate damage payments.

- You examine opportunities for recourse, work with internal specialist offices and external partners and ensure clear, timely communication.

What you bring

- You have an education in insurance; a professional card insurance or a degree from a high school insurance is an advantage.

- You have at least five years of professional experience in handling claims, ideally in property and/or general liability insurance.

- You will bring in-depth knowledge in the coverage and liability assessment as well as experience in dealing with complex claims cases.

- You negotiate safely, perform convincingly even in demanding situations and find pragmatic and customer-oriented solutions.

- You work independently, structured and reliable, communicate very well in German and have good MS-Office skills; Other language skills are an advantage.

(This is a temporary contract till 31.12.2027)

The Finance Transformation is building a leading connected, collaborative Finance Function which is faster and more insight-driven. We will do this by transforming everything we do, every process, data and tool and injecting new ways of work and AI to amplify our Finance talent.

The BA/SME Databricks will play a key role in the technology stream, focusing on business analysis and subject matter expertise to ensure that Databricks is leveraged as defined in the target architecture and roadmap.

This role will work on processes, options and business cases to use Databricks for Finance data integration, analytics and data products, and the role will help Finance teams understand when and how to use Databricks versus other platforms.

What you will do

• Work with Group Finance, BU Finance and data/analytics teams to identify and refine use cases for Databricks (e.g. finance data pipelines, advanced analytics, scenario analysis, data products.

• Gather and challenge business requirements and translate them into clear functional specifications for Databricks solutions.

• Assess which requirements should be implemented on Databricks vs. other platforms (SAP, Anaplan, BI tools), in line with the Finance technology strategy.

• Define and document Finance processes that rely on Databricks (e.g. data preparation for reporting, modelling workflows, analytics).

• Contribute to the Databricks operating model for Finance: roles, responsibilities, ways of working with Group IT / data platform teams.

• Evaluate solution options for Finance needs.

• Develop business cases for Databricks initiatives, including benefits (data quality, automation, speed, insight), effort and cost.

• Support prioritisation of Databricks use cases within the Finance Transformation roadmap.

• Translate business needs/requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria.

• Define test cases and acceptance criteria for Databricks solutions from a Finance perspective.

• Coordinate UAT with Finance users, manage defects and support resolution.

• Ensure Databricks initiatives remain aligned with the target Finance technology and data architecture defined by the Business Solution Architects.

What you bring

• Experience as Business Analyst or SME in Finance, data or analytics projects.

• Good understanding of Finance / Group Finance processes.

• Practical experience with data platforms or analytics environments; hands on exposure to Databricks is a strong advantage.

• Familiarity with concepts such as data pipelines, data modelling, data products, and analytics/BI.

• Experience working with IT / data engineering teams on shared solutions.

• Strong requirements gathering and documentation skills.

• Ability to analyse solution options and build business cases in a clear, structured way.

• Structured, analytical and solution oriented mindset.

• Ability to simplify complexity and communicate clearly to non technical audiences.

• Experience working in complex, global programmes, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.

• Strong collaboration skills and a “one team” attitude, supporting both Finance and IT colleagues.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.

For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Information for recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

La Trasformazione delle Finanze sta costruendo una funzione di finanza collegata e collaborativa che è più veloce e più orientata agli insight. Lo faremo trasformando tutto ciò che facciamo, ogni processo, dati e strumento e iniettando nuovi modi di lavoro e AI per amplificare il nostro talento Finance.

La BA/SME Databricks svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel flusso tecnologico, concentrandosi sull'analisi aziendale e sulle competenze in materia per garantire che Databricks sia sfruttato come definito nell'architettura e nella roadmap di destinazione.

Questo ruolo lavorerà su processi, opzioni e casi di business per utilizzare Databricks per l'integrazione dei dati, analisi e prodotti di dati, e il ruolo aiuterà i team Finance a capire quando e come utilizzare Databricks contro altre piattaforme.

Cosa farai

- Lavora con i team di Group Finance, BU Finance e data/analytics per identificare e perfezionare i casi di utilizzo per Databricks (ad esempio, datadotti finanziari, analisi avanzata, analisi scenari, prodotti dati.

- Raccogliere e sfidare i requisiti aziendali e tradurli in chiare specifiche funzionali per le soluzioni Databricks.

- Valutare quali requisiti dovrebbero essere implementati su Databricks vs. altre piattaforme (strumenti SAP, Anaplan, BI), in linea con la strategia di tecnologia Finance.

- Definire e documentare i processi Finance che si basano su Databricks (ad esempio la preparazione dei dati per la segnalazione, la modellazione dei flussi di lavoro, l'analisi).

- Contribuisci al modello operativo Databricks per Finance: ruoli, responsabilità, modi di lavorare con i team di piattaforme IT / dati di Gruppo.

- Valuta le opzioni di soluzione per le esigenze Finance.

- Sviluppare casi di business per iniziative Databricks, tra cui benefici (qualità dei dati, automazione, velocità, insight), sforzo e costi.

- Supporto priorità di Databricks utilizzare i casi all'interno della roadmap di Finance Transformation.

- Traduci esigenze aziendali / requisiti in storie utente, criteri di accettazione.

- Definire i casi di test e i criteri di accettazione per le soluzioni Databricks da una prospettiva Finance.

- Coordinare UAT con gli utenti Finance, gestire i difetti e la risoluzione di supporto.

- Assicurare che le iniziative di Databricks rimangano allineate con la tecnologia di finanza di destinazione e l'architettura dei dati definita dagli Architetti Business Solution.

Cosa porti

- Esperienza come Business Analyst o PMI nei progetti di finanza, dati o analisi.

- Buona comprensione dei processi Finance / Group Finance.

- Esperienza pratica con piattaforme di dati o ambienti di analisi; mani su esposizione a Databricks è un forte vantaggio.

- Familiarità con concetti come datadotti, modellazione dati, prodotti dati e analisi/BI.

- Esperienza di lavoro con team IT / data engineering su soluzioni condivise.

- Forti requisiti di raccolta e capacità di documentazione.

- Capacità di analizzare le opzioni di soluzione e costruire casi aziendali in modo chiaro e strutturato.
